Review Zing AI Fitness Coach?

Zing AI Fitness Coach earns praise for approachable, highly personalized workouts, clear progress tracking, and motivating AI guidance that adapts to energy, goals, and limitations. Users highlight friendly onboarding, reminders, and the Body Scan as standouts, with some sharing notable weight-loss results and daily use. Critiques focus on missing basics: rest-timer alerts, robust exercise library, logging reps/sets/weights, and better variety to avoid repetitive programming; multitasking pauses timers. A maker behind Zing notes consistent motivation and fit-to-level plans, reinforcing trust while users anticipate continued feature upgrades.

results.content: Hi! Absolutely love this app & it's helped me with the gym so much, however l've run into a few issues and have a few suggestions. The other day, I noticed my health info in settings was all off. My watch had been tracking my activity every minute - so my workout minutes were at 4x over what they actually were, and my workouts were being tracked 2 or 3 times in my data in apple Health from my watch. I also wanted to suggest, during a workout session, I think you should be able to re-order workouts. I've run into this several times in the gym where if a machine or equipment is unavailable, I'll want to move on to another workout in Zing & come back to the other when the machine is available, but there's no option to re-order the workouts. Then I just get frustrated because I can't switch [...] Hello,Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for choosing Zing Coach to guide your fitness journey! We're thrilled to hear how the app has positively impacted your daily routine, energy levels, and overall well-being. It's fantastic that you've been able to customize your meal plans with the help of your AI coach—what a great use of the app's features!Regarding your comment about calorie logging, currently, Zing Coach does not have a built-in calorie tracking feature. However, we appreciate your feedback and are always looking to improve the app based on user suggestions.If you have any more questions or need further assistance, please feel free to reach out through the ‘Contact Zing’ option in the app's settings or by emailing support@zing.coach.Keep up the great work, and [...] workouts. Then I just get frustrated because I can't switch around my workout based on what equipment I can use. For example, if the order of my workout in Zing is dumbbell press, and then chest press machine next... if the bench isn't open for me to do the dumbbell press, I can't reorder or skip ahead to do the chest press machine at that moment while waiting for a bench to open. That would be EXTREMELY helpful. I also really value the rating how hard or easy a set was, and it only pops up and asks me for a few workouts, if there was a button at the bottom of the screen for each workout to optionally tell Zing how hard or difficult it was, this would be helpful.
